verdict.rationale: Teller ships a drop-in connection widget: the docs reference integrating and customizing Teller Connect, and an official React hook/component exists. That covers opening a hosted flow without building institution UI yourself. However, the evidence never describes creating a session server-side or receiving an access token for the connected account, so the end-to-end flow in the story is only partly shown. Missing for 10: documented server-side session creation step, documented token/enrollment returned to the app on success, independent hands-on corroboration of the Connect flow.
